visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with long, dark, wavy hair. She is wearing a sleeveless tweed patterned vest in shades of beige and brown over a colorful red, blue, and white vertically striped blouse. She has large, dangling pink tassel earrings and her makeup is soft and professional. She stands in front of a traditional Chinese studio set featuring red lattice window screens and a large arrangement of pink plum blossoms. She smiles warmly and begins speaking directly into the lens. (2) As she speaks, graphic overlays appear. On the top left, a name logo '雨揚老師 Yu Young' is displayed. On the right, a vertical red banner reads '十二生肖（蛇）年運勢'. At the bottom, a website URL 'www.yohofate.com' is visible. Periodically, a circular icon with a cartoon animal corresponding to a zodiac sign (like a rat, ox, or tiger) appears on the left side of the frame as she discusses their specific fortune. She uses subtle hand gestures and nods to emphasize her points. (3) The scene maintains this consistent setup for most of the video's duration. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her features and the details of her clothing. The background remains out of focus to keep the attention on the speaker. The woman continues her explanation of each zodiac sign with a pleasant and engaging facial expression, moving through all twelve animals sequentially. (4) In the final moments, the video cuts to a full-screen graphic animation on a deep red background. A cute, 3D animated golden snake wearing a traditional red hat and holding a red lantern appears on the right side. On the left, large stylized gold Chinese characters read '金蛇迎春' and below it '2025'. In the center, 'HAPPY NEW YEAR 2025' is written in English. The graphic is vibrant and festive.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track features a single, clear female voice speaking in Mandarin. Her tone is professional, authoritative yet friendly, and very well-enunciated, typical of a professional presenter or narrator. In the background, a soft, melodic traditional Chinese instrumental piece plays, featuring the bright, plucked sounds of a guzheng and the airy tones of a dizi (bamboo flute). The music has a moderate, steady tempo with a major tonality, creating a harmonious and positive atmosphere. (2) As the speaker transitions between each of the twelve zodiac signs, a subtle, high-pitched digital chime or bell-like sound effect (SFX) is heard, serving as a structural marker. The speaker's voice remains consistently centered in the stereo field, with a moderate volume level that perfectly balances with the background music. There is almost no background noise, indicating a professional studio recording with high-quality equipment and sound isolation. (3) The speaker's prosody is dynamic, with natural rising and falling intonations that keep the listener engaged. Her speech rate is comfortable for the viewer to follow while being dense with information. The background music continues uninterrupted, providing a rhythmic bed for her narration. The track ends with the speaker's final greeting, followed by a slight swell in the music and a final soft chime as the video concludes.
